Dataset: tax
Description: Synthetic tax records (one per person): salary, tax rate and exemptions by US state.
Statistics below come from a training sample of 20,000 records.

Columns:
  salary: annual salary in US dollars; numeric, min 5000, median 50000, max 100000, share of zeros 0.0%; missing 0.0%
  rate: state income tax rate in percent; numeric, min 0, median 4.75, max 9.3, share of zeros 21.5%; missing 0.0%
  single_exemp: state tax exemption for single filers, US dollars; numeric, min 0, median 0, max 12750, share of zeros 63.1%; missing 0.0%
  married_exemp: state tax exemption for married filers, US dollars; numeric, min 0, median 0, max 24500, share of zeros 63.7%; missing 0.0%
  child_exemp: state tax exemption per child, US dollars; numeric, min 0, median 0, max 3300, share of zeros 62.9%; missing 0.0%
  gender: F or M; text, 2 distinct values; most common: F (50.7%), M (49.2%); missing 0.0%
  state: US state of the address (two-letter code); text, 53 distinct values; most common: MO (2.1%), SC (2.1%), FL (2.1%), ME (2.1%), WY (2.1%), MN (2.0%), GA (2.0%), OK (2.0%); missing 0.0%
  marital_status: M = married, S = single; text, 2 distinct values; most common: M (50.1%), S (49.9%); missing 0.0%
  has_child: Y = has at least one child, N = no children; text, 2 distinct values; most common: Y (50.2%), N (49.8%); missing 0.0%
  zip: US postal code of the person's address; text, 14,287 distinct values; most common: 01907 (0.2%), 02852 (0.1%), 96734 (0.0%), 02916 (0.0%), 02817 (0.0%), 02905 (0.0%), 02842 (0.0%), 02881 (0.0%); missing 0.0%
